title: CLARKSONS HELLAS - SnP WEEKLY
summary:
Main
Crude export volumes through the Strait of Hormuz have recovered to near pre-crisis levels, supported by using shuttletankers and ship-to-ship (STS) transfers, with Aramco reportedly considering this approach as a longer-term solution. Under the revised arrangement, responsibility shifts from buyers, who traditionally secured tankers for loading at Saudi ports, to exporters, who assume the risk of transporting crude through Hormuz to the Gulf of Oman. Buyers then take delivery and arrange onward transportation using a separate vessel.
